title: ORBIT
creator: VELMREN
description: Operations workspace for an online store: linked orders, payments, stock, tasks and customer messages, with a command menu, notifications, bulk actions, a drag-and-drop task board, team roles with a view-as preview and motion throughout. Russian and English.
data: Fictional store Northline Objects: about 14,000 orders and 10,000 customers over eighteen months, generated deterministically; reporting date 29 September 2026
persistence: Changes are kept in the browser as an action log replayed over the generated data; no server
